key_features: Durable Blue Mechanical Switches: Offers tactile, clicky feedback and boasts a long lifespan—rated for up to 50 million keystrokes.
Dual-Language Layout: Keycaps support both English and Bengali typing—ideal for multilingual users.
Reliable Wired USB 2.0 Connection: Plug-and-play setup ensures lag-free, responsive performance across a wide range of operating systems.
Efficient Power Usage: Operates at 5V and draws less than 300 mA, making it energy-efficient and straightforward to install.
Portable and Cable-Friendly: Includes a detachable USB cable for easy portability and neat cable management.
